test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **'which'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'which' **correctly references the preceding noun **'computer series'.**
 
• It is non-restrictive, adding non-essential info but clarifying the subject.
 
• **Free from rote learning **is an important detail about Cyber Beans series.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'which'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **whose** is incorrect because it is used for possessive cases, and the sentence does not intend to show possession.
 
• **who** is incorrect because it refers to people, not things.
 
• **this** is incorrect because it does not serve the relative clause purpose needed here.

 

The Passage:__ KIPS, with its vast (1) __experience__ in School Computer Education, (2) __has designed__ the computer Series - Cyber Beans. This is the (3) __most__ comprehensive computer series, (4) __**which**__ is free from rote learning. While designing this series, a lot of effort has been put in to give each (5) _______ a practical shape.
